mapper.select: SELECT i.id, i.plan_id, i.cargo_order_id, i.shipment_id, i.group_code, i.pre_location, -- JOIN oms_cargo_order o.cargo_order_no, o.business_type_name, o.platform_name, o.address_type, o.order_status, o.platform_warehouse_code, -- JOIN oms_cargo_order_shipment s.shipment_no, s.po_no, s.shipping_mark, s.carton_qty, s.weight, s.cbm, s.pallet_qty FROM wms_inbound_plan_item i LEFT JOIN oms_cargo_order o ON o.id = i.cargo_order_id AND o.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN oms_cargo_order_shipment s ON s.id = i.shipment_id AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE i.plan_id = #{planId} AND i.deleted = 0 ORDER BY i.group_code, i.id

SELECT i.group_code, SUM(s.cbm) AS total_cbm, SUM(s.carton_qty) AS total_carton_qty, SUM(s.weight) AS total_weight, COUNT(i.id) AS item_count FROM wms_inbound_plan_item i LEFT JOIN oms_cargo_order_shipment s ON s.id = i.shipment_id AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE i.plan_id = #{planId} AND i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.group_code ORDER BY i.group_code
